entities.name: PMID:27518489
observations: Grossman et al., Clin J Pain 2017;33(5):385-394; DOI:10.1097/AJP.0000000000000420. Three-arm RCT of 168 women with fibromyalgia comparing 8-week MBSR with wait-list and active control; ambulatory monitoring at baseline, postintervention, and 8-week follow-up.

entities.name: MBSR null ambulatory outcomes
observations: In women with fibromyalgia, MBSR showed no treatment effect on ambulatory activity heart rate, respiratory sinus arrhythmia, ventilation, or accelerometry-derived daily activity; patient-reported improvement was not related to objective physiological or activity changes.
